templates.title: Name Change Affidavit
templates.body: I hereby solemnly affirm that my old name and new name belong to one and the same person.

templates.title: Birth Certificate Correction
templates.body: I declare that the particulars mentioned herein are true and correct and request correction in official records.

templates.title: Loss of Documents
templates.body: I solemnly state that the original documents have been lost and are not traceable despite best efforts.

templates.title: Income Certificate
templates.body: I hereby declare that the income details furnished are true and correct.
